title: "Do not bolus, record only" not available when no Omnipod pump active
body:
**AndroidAPS** 3.0.0.1
**Build**: Release
**Pump**: DASH

**Problem description:** (_Enhancement_)
When a DASH pod deactivates (due to expiration or pod failure) immediate replacement is not always convenient or possible.
User may need to fall back to temporary insulin treatment using PEN insulin.

* With an active Pod user can use "Do not bolus, record only" with optional time offset
* With no Pod is active (expired/discarded) the Insulin button is removed and "record only" is not available.

**Additional Info**
Any insulin treatment while no Pod is active must be registered in AAPS for correct IOB on activating a new Pod. With current functionality user can only do so by making notes on insulin treatment (units + time) and then register with negative time offset after activating a new Pod.

comments.body:
we decided to not allow it because it could be confusing. People don't read messages like it's record only.
You can enter insulin afterwards
